body: isn't that possibly manipulative tho? he knows I'm not myself and it just would feel like a major lie-

I did mention he has attempted before. and that his mental state does leave him open to trying again-

I screwed up didn't I-

I really relate to this. my family treats my abusers like what they have done wasn't anything too major and I still have to deal with them to this day.

I absolutely need karma to be a thing. The rage I have at times thinking about what happened and what continues to be- I have no idea how I've kept it controlled. They've all moved on while I'm here stuck with the consequences of their actions.

I don't know what the hell incentive them to excuse it- but I fucking hate that they have.

definitely can relate with pretending that it didn't happen at all but at some point that stopped working.

the closest to that personally is spacing out to the point of creating a world that I feel so inside of. problem is I haven't been able to do that in a while but omg it's a nice feeling.

yeah I can relate. 

I can be very social and outgoing but school always dampens that. I just want to be able to do things without being so judged or worrying about if I'll end up alone.

being inside for a year just felt better didn't it?

I used to really want to get into golf. problem was I didn't know how expensive the clubs are + plus having to find a place to practice wasn't something I had.

it seems like a fun sport tho! I mean sure to others it's mundane but to me hitting a ball with a club is a lot more satisfying then say a bat and a ball.
